messages:
Maya L.: starting a thread to coordinate doc changes for the Zephyr-Extended 70B model card after the latest perf run. need: an embeddings SDK migration snippet, explicit max token limit, a short compatibility note, and a tiny bench summary.
Rohit S.: I can draft the SDK snippet. which API style are we standardizing on? v2 with client.embeddings.create?
Maya L.: yes, v2. and please include an example showing batching vs single input. keep examples minimal.
Kai W.: infra bench highlights: fp16 q4 config, single-GPU throughput ~18 rps for single requests, p95 end-to-end embed latency ~220ms, max embed input tokens observed stable at 8192. put the 8192 number prominently.
Ana P.: compatibility note: older runtimes (<=2024-11-01) don't support the Extended KV cache and will be routed to zephyr-70b. we should call that out under "Compatibility" and link to runtime matrix.
Rohit S.: snippet draft: ```# legacy
vec = client.embed("hello")

# v2
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="zephyr-extended-70b-embed", input=["hello"]) 
vec = resp.data[0].embedding
``` Add: "For batching, pass multiple items in input to improve throughput."
Maya L.: nice. add a tiny batching example for throughput: `input=["s1","s2","s3"]` and a note to prefer batch sizes 8-32 depending on GPU.
Kai W.: add CLI bench command for reproducibility: `rdi bench --model zephyr-extended-70b-embed --batch 16 --input-shape 4096`
Ana P.: proposed model card text for limits: "Max embedding input tokens: 8192. Recommended batch size: 8-32. Single-GPU throughput (fp16, q4): ~18 req/s for single-request workloads; use batching for higher aggregate throughput." Add caveat: "Large single-request sizes may OOM on older dedicated stacks 1024. Chunk inputs when necessary."
Maya L.: nit: change "single-GPU" wording to "single-host"? I prefer single-GPU to be clearer.
Ana P.: updated to "single-GPU". also included the runtime fallback sentence.
docs-bot: PR created by @rohits: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/418 1abels: docs, needs-review
Maya L.: assigning reviewers @Kai W. and @Ana P. will review today. please keep changes minimal and link bench report.
Kai W.: reviewed, small wording tweak on caveat. LGTM after that.
Rohit S.: pushed changes and fixed a broken link to runtime compatibility matrix. CI passing.
